subject: Animation
title: Strange World and the Box Office Question
description: A quick win: understand Strange World and the Box Office Question.

hook.text: Strange World in 2022 lost Disney over $100 million, raising questions about the future of theatrical animation.

buildup.text: Audiences increasingly chose streaming over theaters for animated films after the pandemic changed viewing habits.

discovery.text: Disney had trained families to wait for Disney Plus releases, accidentally undermining their own theatrical business.

twist.text: Meanwhile, Spider-Verse and Mario proved audiences will still pack theaters for the right animated event.

climax.text: The struggle between streaming and theaters is reshaping how Disney plans every animated film's release.

punchline.text: Disney accidentally taught audiences to skip theaters for streaming.

quiz.question: What challenge did Strange World's failure highlight for Disney animation?
options: Audiences no longer enjoy animated films
Post-pandemic viewing habits and Disney Plus trained families to skip theaters for streaming
The film was too expensive to produce

details.summary: Strange World became one of Disney's biggest box office failures, losing an estimated $147 million. Despite featuring Disney's first openly gay teen romance and an environmental message, poor marketing and audience fatigue contributed to its unprecedented commercial failure.
details.whyItMatters: Strange World's failure raised questions about whether Disney can still reliably open animated films in theaters. In a streaming-dominated market, even Disney's brand and quality are no guarantee of commercial success.
takeaways: Strange World lost an estimated $147 million at the box office
It featured Disney's first openly gay teen romantic subplot
The failure raised questions about theatrical animation's commercial future

faq.question: Why did Strange World fail at the box office?
faq.answer: A near-invisible marketing campaign, audience fatigue with Disney+ sending animated films straight to streaming, and a Thanksgiving release competing with other entertainment all contributed. The film had no hit song or recognizable fairy tale property to drive awareness.

faq.question: What does Strange World's failure mean for Disney animation?
faq.answer: It highlighted the challenge of releasing animated films theatrically when audiences expect them on Disney+ quickly. Disney must now fight against the devaluation of theatrical animation that its own streaming strategy helped create.
